title: FootInsights settled football predictions
subtitle: Every pre-match probability FootInsights published, settled against final score
description:
Every pre-match probability FootInsights (https://footinsights.com) has published since August 2026, settled against the final score. One row per settled call: a market of a match (the model's 1X2, double chance, over/under 1.5/2.5/3.5, both-teams-to-score and correct-score calls, and the published tips), the call and what happened, the match's 1X2, over 2.5 and BTTS probabilities, the model's public version name and the settlement time. Append-only: nothing is edited or removed after publication, misses included.

Column reference: https://footinsights.com/data/
Live file, refreshed with every pipeline run: https://footinsights.com/data/predictions.csv
Source repository (weekly copy, monthly release): https://github.com/FootInsights/footinsights-data
DOI, all versions: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23471483
Track record and calibration of the same rows: https://footinsights.com/track-record/

Licence: CC BY 4.0. Cite as: FootInsights (2026). FootInsights settled football predictions. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23471483

resources.description: Every prediction FootInsights published and settled, one row per call: a market of a match, the call, the outcome, the match probabilities, the model version and the settlement time. Fields can be empty where a value was never recorded.

fields.name: market
fields.description: Market. The model's calls: 1x2, dc (double chance), ou15/ou25/ou35 (over/under 1.5/2.5/3.5), btts, cs (correct score). The published tips: result, goals and both (the three tips frozen per match with their price), best (the Best Tip), banker and value (the Value Bet).

fields.name: predicted
fields.description: Our call: home/draw/away, 1X/12/X2, over/under, yes/no, a scoreline, or market/selection for best and banker.

fields.name: actual
fields.description: What happened, same vocabulary as predicted.

fields.name: correct
fields.description: true when the call matched the outcome.

fields.name: p_home
fields.description: Published probability of a home win (0-1).

fields.name: p_away
fields.description: Published probability of an away win (0-1).

fields.name: p_btts
fields.description: Published probability of both teams scoring (0-1).

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Model confidence in the main pick (0-1).

fields.name: model_version
fields.description: Public name of the FootInsights model version that priced the match (e.g. v3.1); blank where a version has no public name.

fields.name: settled_at
fields.description: When the prediction was settled, ISO 8601, UTC.

fields.name: match_url
fields.description: Permanent URL of the match's prediction page.
